facts.fact: The MGLSD feasibility report says numerous Ugandan social protection programmes operate their own management information systems, including those for the Senior Citizens Grant, the Youth Livelihood Programme and SAGE.
facts.system: programme MISs (Senior Citizens Grant, Youth Livelihood Programme, SAGE)

facts.fact: The MGLSD feasibility report says the MISs of various programmes are linked to the National Single Registry, which provides an integrated beneficiary management platform.
